text:
Kevin: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down remediation ownership and timelines for rollout safeguards. Items: auto-rollback thresholds, blast-radius caps, feature-flag kill-switch, recurring pattern tracking. Who can pick primary owners?
Maria: I can take ownership of blast-radius caps and the rollout config template. I’ll draft a PR with defaults. ETA EOD Thu.
Ajay: I’ll own auto-rollback heuristics + alerting. Proposal: combine a 5m error-rate spike >= 3x baseline AND p95 latency increase >= 2x to trigger rollback. Also enforce min_canary_sample=0.5% and max_canary_sample=10%.
Kevin: OK @Ajay — can you put those thresholds into the runbook and add a test plan for canary-sims? We need reproducible tests before rolling to prod.
Ajay: On it. Pushed a sketch to the runbook page (see link in the doc). Will add unit tests for the detector.
Sara: small ask: add a soft-quarantine state to the rollout flow (pause ramp, keep canary nodes up for inspection, run isolation checks). Example flag config below:
```yaml
flag:
  name: experiment/fastpath
  stage: canary
  min_sample: 0.01
  max_sample: 0.1
  quarantine: true
  rollback_policy:
    errors: 0.03 # fraction
    latency_p95: 2.0 # multiplier
    window_secs: 300
```
Maria: nice. i’ll add a "blast_radius" field to the template so teams can scope to customer segments/regions and avoid global impact. will include owner metadata and a link to the PR template.
Kevin: for recurring incident detection, assign Sara to lead quarterly audits to detect regression clusters (time-of-day, model rollout correlation, infra changes). we should surface clusters in Console.
Sara: will create a dashboard query + recurring alert that flags similar stack traces + correlated rollouts. will include a simple similarity score.
Kevin: action items recap — Ajay -> auto-rollback heuristics + runbook (ETA Tue), Maria -> rollout config template + PR (ETA Thu EOD), Sara -> quarantine state + dashboard (ETA next Tue), Kevin -> coordinate rollout drills and add new items to oncall playbook.
rollout-bot: noted tasks created: RB-2024, RB-2025, RB-2026. CC @product-ops
Kevin: thanks — let's do a quick check-in Fri 09:30 to validate PRs and sim outputs. :thumbsup:
